mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it triggers a restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates and reduces forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a rising residential construction index signals strong household demand that supports corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST increases > 0.5% in 1 month during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below its 12-month moving average by more than 1.0%, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profitability and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when INDPRO falls below 12-month MA by > 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer credit (RSAFS) over six consecutive months indicates rising household spending power that drives corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS increases for six consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and rise in unemployment rate signals a broad economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises for two consecutive months.
